title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Four Bar Positions (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `img_bars4` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Four discrete spatial bar locations (two vertical, two horizontal) on 8x8 grayscale images.
